content.user_title: Map the Current CookMode V2 Codebase
content.value_statement: Understanding an unfamiliar codebase is slow when architecture and file ownership are unclear. This skill produces factual maps of CookMode V2 components, data flow, and implementation locations.
actual_capabilities: Explains the documented React component flow from App through recipe views.
Maps the documented Supabase, React hook, and real-time data flow.
Identifies referenced CookMode V2 files and documented line ranges.
Produces factual component and feature documentation in Markdown.
Summarizes the documented styling approach and database tables.
limitations: It documents only the CookMode V2 implementation available in the working project.
It does not verify that referenced files or line numbers remain current without inspecting them.
It avoids recommendations, refactoring plans, and root-cause analysis unless explicitly requested.
It cannot implement changes or run the application by itself.

use_cases.title: Onboard to the recipe application
use_cases.description: Request a map of the main components and data flow before making your first change.

use_cases.title: Locate a feature implementation
use_cases.description: Find the documented files and interactions behind recipe scaling or real-time updates.

use_cases.title: Prepare technical handoff notes
use_cases.description: Create a factual overview of the current architecture for teammates or stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what RecipeModal does in CookMode V2. Include where it fits in the component flow.

prompt_templates.title: Trace recipe data
prompt_templates.prompt: Describe how recipe data moves from local state to Supabase and back to connected clients.

prompt_templates.title: Map recipe scaling
prompt_templates.prompt: Document the current recipe-scaling feature. Include the relevant files, documented line ranges, data changes, and interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Create an architecture reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a factual Markdown architecture map for CookMode V2. Cover frontend structure, hooks, Supabase integration, styling, and database tables. Do not suggest changes.

output: Recipe scaling is documented in RecipeModal, the scaling utility, and the recipe-data hook.
The flow updates order counts, recalculates ingredient quantities, and persists the order count through Supabase.
The documented flow initializes Supabase, manages recipe state through a custom hook, and uses a real-time hook for client synchronization.
Local changes update the interface before persistence and subscription updates.

best_practices: Ask for a specific feature, component, or data path when possible.
Request file paths and interactions when preparing implementation work.
Ask explicitly for analysis or recommendations if you need more than factual documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the documentation as proof that the current repository has not changed.
Do not expect unsolicited refactoring or performance recommendations.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for testing runtime behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It creates factual documentation about CookMode V2 architecture, files, components, and data flow.

faq.question: Does it suggest code improvements?
faq.answer: No. It stays descriptive unless you explicitly request analysis or recommendations.

faq.question: Can it identify where a feature is implemented?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map documented feature behavior to referenced files and line ranges.

faq.question: Does it explain Supabase integration?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the stated Supabase client, persistence, and real-time synchronization flow.

faq.question: Can it verify the running application?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and does not run or test the application.

faq.question: What format does it use?
faq.answer: It uses clear Markdown with descriptions, locations, implementation details, and interactions.
